app_privacyText: Snuffel has no accounts and no tracking. Your dogs, reminders, saved places and chats stay on this phone. Your location is only used to search and is not stored. Questions to the AI assistant are sent to Azure OpenAI in the EU and are not used for training.
app_aboutText: Snuffel helps you find independent vets, groomers, shops, trainers, dog hotels and play areas across Europe, and shows which places belong to large chains.
